Award of the Global Talent Scholarship 2026/27

Dear Mr Rivera,

On behalf of the Selection Committee, I am delighted to inform you that you have been awarded a
Global Talent Scholarship for the academic year 2026/27. The Committee was particularly
impressed by your academic record and by the data-literacy workshops you co-organise for
students at Hochschule Musterstadt.

Scholarship details
• The monthly stipend of EUR 450.00 will be paid from October 2026 to September 2027 by
bank transfer on or around the first working day of each month.
• Funding period: 1 October 2026 – 30 September 2027 (12 months).
• Scholarship ID: GTSF-2026-0317 (please quote it in all correspondence).

Conditions
1. You remain enrolled as a full-time student at Hochschule Musterstadt throughout the funding
period and upload your certificate of enrolment for each semester to the scholarship portal.
2. Your first progress report is due on 15 December 2026. Please submit it through the
scholarship portal using the template provided there. The report (max. two pages) must be
countersigned by your academic supervisor.
3. Please notify us of any change of address, bank details or study status within two weeks of
the change.
4. Other scholarships or grants must be reported to us before you accept them.

The scholarship is granted to cover living costs while studying. It is generally tax-free under § 3
No. 44 of the German Income Tax Act (EStG); please keep this letter for your records.

We look forward to welcoming you to our scholar community at the Autumn Meeting in Berlin on 7
November 2026. A separate invitation with the programme will follow.

Yours sincerely,

Dr. Helen Example
Programme Director
